title: How Worker Productivity and Wages Grow with Tenure and Experience: The Firm Perspective
title_zh: 任期与经验如何促进工人生产率与工资增长：企业视角
authors: Caplin, Andrew, Lee, Minjoon, Leth-Petersen, Søren, Shapiro, Matthew D.
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Macroeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: How worker productivity evolves with tenure and experience shapes life-cycle earnings and losses from job separation. Yet, worker-level productivity is hard to identify from observational data. This paper introduces a firm survey designed to separate effects of on-the-job tenure from sector-specific experience on the trajectory of on-the-job productivity. Several findings emerge. (i) On-the-job productivity growth initially exceeds wage growth, consistent with wages not being allocative period-by-period. (ii) Previous sector-specific experience reduces on-the-job tenure needed, though not by one-to-one, to reach a maximal productivity. (iii) There is substantial heterogeneity across jobs in the extent that previous sector-specific experience reduces tenure needed.
abstract_zh: 工人生产率随任期与经验的演变，决定了生命周期内的收入水平及失业造成的损失。然而，从观测数据中识别工人层面的生产率存在困难。本文引入一项企业调查，旨在分离在职任期与行业特定经验对在职生产率轨迹的影响。研究得出以下发现：（i）在职生产率的初始增长超过工资增长，这与工资并非逐期配置性调整的结论一致；（ii）先前的行业特定经验可缩短达到最大生产率所需的在职任期，但并非完全替代关系；（iii）不同岗位中，先前行业特定经验对缩短所需任期的影响存在显著异质性。

title: Voice and distortion: When representatives misread the room
title_zh: 声音与扭曲：当代表们误判局势时
authors: Kirill Chernomaz
abstract: A representative chooses policy on behalf of a group with heterogeneous preferences. Group members differ in voice (their salience to the representative). The representative maximizes perceived welfare based on a voice-weighted signal. The resulting policy distortion is proportional to the covariance between voice and preferences. When agents choose voice effort endogenously, equilibrium voice is U-shaped (quadratic in distance between preferences and policy). The equilibrium distortion is approximately one-third of a standard deviation times the skewness coefficient. It is non-zero only when the preference distribution is skewed. Combining the voice-weighted signal with a random sample can reduce the expected welfare loss. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
abstract_zh: 一位代表代表一个偏好异质性的群体制定政策。群体成员在话语权（即其对代表的重要性）上存在差异。代表基于话语权加权的信号最大化感知福利。由此产生的政策扭曲与话语权和偏好之间的协方差成正比。当代理人内生地选择话语努力时，均衡话语呈U形（即偏好与政策距离的二次函数）。均衡扭曲约为标准差的三分之一乘以偏度系数。只有当偏好分布呈偏态时，该扭曲才非零。将话语权加权信号与随机样本相结合，可以减少预期福利损失。

title: Strategic Stake Acquisitions in Rival Firms: Common vs. Cross‐Ownership
title_zh: 竞争对手企业中的战略性股权收购：共同所有权与交叉所有权
authors: Vincenzo Denicolò, Fausto Panunzi
abstract: We study how a blockholder who controls a firm should acquire a minority stake in a rival: directly, creating common ownership , or indirectly through the controlled firm, creating cross‐ownership . Common ownership generates stronger internalization of competitive externalities and allows the blockholder to capture the resulting gains without sharing them with dispersed shareholders. However, it may also create conflicts of interest with minority shareholders that can lead to a loss of control. Cross‐ownership avoids this governance risk but internalizes competition less effectively. We characterize how the optimal acquisition mode depends on the nature of product market competition and the strength of corporate governance.
abstract_zh: 我们研究控制一家公司的大股东应如何获取竞争对手的少数股权：是直接获取（形成共同所有权），还是通过所控制的公司间接获取（形成交叉所有权）。共同所有权能更有效地内化竞争外部性，并使大股东在不与分散股东分享收益的情况下获取由此产生的收益。然而，这可能会与少数股东产生利益冲突，进而导致控制权丧失。交叉所有权可规避这种治理风险，但内化竞争的效果较差。我们刻画了最优收购模式如何取决于产品市场竞争的性质以及公司治理的强度。

title: Monetary Policy without Commitment
title_zh: 无承诺的货币政策
authors: Hassan Afrouzi, Marina Halac, Kenneth Rogoff, Pierre Yared
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies the implications of central bank credibility for long-run inflation and inflation dynamics. We introduce central bank lack of commitment into a standard nonlinear New Keynesian economy with sticky-price monopolistically competitive firms. Inflation is driven by the interaction of lack of commitment and the economic environment. We show that long-run inflation increases following an unanticipated permanent increase in the labor wedge or decrease in the elasticity of substitution across varieties. In the transition, inflation overshoots and then gradually declines. Quantitatively, inflation overshooting is persistent, and the welfare loss from lack of commitment relative to inflation targeting is large. (JEL D43, E12, E23, E24, E31, E52, E58)
abstract_zh: 本文研究了中央银行可信度对长期通胀及通胀动态的影响。我们将中央银行缺乏承诺的特征引入标准非线性新凯恩斯经济模型（该模型包含粘性价格与垄断竞争企业）。通胀由缺乏承诺与经济环境的相互作用共同驱动。研究表明，当劳动楔子出现未预期的永久性上升或品种间替代弹性下降时，长期通胀水平将随之上升。在过渡阶段，通胀会出现超调现象，随后逐步回落。从量化角度看，通胀超调具有持续性，且相较于通胀目标制，缺乏承诺导致的福利损失较为显著。（JEL分类号：D43, E12, E23, E24, E31, E52, E58）

title: Dominated Pension Investments: The Role of Search Frictions and Unawareness
title_zh: 受支配的养老金投资：搜索摩擦与认知缺失的作用
authors: Karin Kinnerud, Louise Lorentzon
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Applied Economics · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We conduct a large-scale field experiment in the Swedish pension system to examine to what extent information and search frictions explain dominated high-fee index fund choices. Three findings stand out: (i) Letters that increase awareness of a dominated choice and reduce search costs of finding the dominating alternative improve savers’ investment choices. (ii) While the average effects are positive, a majority of investors are unresponsive to information that essentially removes search costs. The inertia holds across expected gains, rejecting models with fixed adjustment costs. (iii) Lack of awareness and search costs account for at most 45 percent of dominated choices. (JEL C93, D83, G23, G51, G53, J32)
abstract_zh: 我们在瑞典养老金系统中开展了一项大规模实地实验，以探究信息和搜索摩擦在多大程度上解释了被高费率指数基金主导的劣质选择。三个主要发现如下：（i）提高对劣质选择认知度并降低寻找更优替代方案搜索成本的函件，改善了储蓄者的投资选择。（ii）尽管平均效应为正，但大多数投资者对实质上消除了搜索成本的信息无动于衷。这种惯性在预期收益范围内普遍存在，从而否定了固定调整成本模型。（iii）认知缺失和搜索成本最多只能解释45%的劣质选择。（JEL分类号：C93, D83, G23, G51, G53, J32）

title: Politics of Food: An Experiment on Trust in Expert Regulation and Economic Costs of Political Polarisation
title_zh: 食品政治：专家监管信任与政治极化经济成本的实验研究
authors: Christopher Burnitt, Jared Gars, Mateusz Stalinski
abstract: Abstract Rising polarisation heightens concerns about politicising regulatory agencies, prompting reassessment of the accountability–independence trade-off. We study whether perceived out-group oversight affects trust in regulation and market behaviour. Using US television transcripts, we show that media link agencies with presidents. We then conduct a field experiment (N=5,566) using a case where the EPA endorsed antibiotic spraying on citrus crops during both Trump’s and Biden’s presidencies. Holding science constant, out-group oversight reduces support for spraying by 26%, lowers trust in EPA’s evaluation, and increases donations to an opposing NGO by 15%. In an obfuscated follow-up, citrus demand is unchanged, but effects differ by consumption habits.
abstract_zh: 摘要 日益加剧的政治极化引发了对监管机构政治化的担忧，促使人们重新审视问责与独立之间的权衡。本文研究了感知到的外群体监督是否会影响公众对监管的信任及市场行为。通过分析美国电视新闻转录文本，我们发现媒体常将监管机构与总统关联。随后，我们以美国环保署（EPA）在特朗普和拜登总统任期内均批准在柑橘作物上喷洒抗生素的案例为基础，开展了一项实地实验（样本量N=5,566）。在保持科学依据不变的情况下，外群体监督使受访者对喷洒措施的支持率下降26%，对EPA评估的信任度降低，并向反对该措施的NGO捐款增加15%。在一项隐蔽的后续实验中，柑橘需求未发生显著变化，但不同消费习惯群体的反应存在差异。

title: Output Quality, Productivity, and Demand: Evidence from the Chinese Steel Industry
title_zh: 产出质量、生产率与需求：来自中国钢铁行业的证据
authors: Jing Li, Shengyu Li, Hongsong Zhang
abstract: Unobserved objective output quality complicates the analysis of firm productivity and demand because higher‐quality products entail higher costs but offer greater consumption benefits. Using a panel of firms with output quality data, we decompose quantity‐based productivity into fundamental productivity and the costs of quality, and separate the demand residual into fundamental demand and quality benefits. Fundamental demand accounts for most revenue variation, whereas quality's revenue‐enhancing benefits are largely offset by its costs. During the 2008 global financial crisis, shifts in quality diverged from changes in fundamental productivity and demand, highlighting the role of quality in assessing firm and industry performance.
abstract_zh: 未观测到的客观产出质量使企业生产率与需求分析复杂化，因为更高质量的产品虽带来更高成本，却提供更大的消费效用。基于包含产出质量数据的企业面板数据，我们将基于数量的生产率分解为基础生产率与质量成本，并将需求残差分离为基础需求与质量收益。基础需求解释了大部分收入变动，而质量带来的收入提升效应在很大程度上被其成本所抵消。在2008年全球金融危机期间，质量变动与基础生产率及需求变化呈现分化态势，凸显了质量在评估企业与行业绩效中的关键作用。

title: Returns to Inventors
title_zh: 发明者的回报
authors: Otto Toivanen, Lotta Väänänen
official: 官方在线 2010-03-14 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: A key input to inventive activity is human capital. Hence it is important to understand the monetary incentives of inventors. We estimate the effect of patented inventions on individual earnings by linking data on U.S. patents and their inventors to Finnish employer-employee data. Returns are heterogeneous: Inventors get a temporary reward of 3% of annual earnings for a patent grant and for highly-cited patents a longer-lasting premium of 30% in earnings three years later. Similar medium-term premia accrue to inventors who initially hold the patent rights, although they forego earnings at the time of the grant.
abstract_zh: 发明活动的关键投入是人力资本。因此，理解发明者的货币激励至关重要。我们通过将美国专利及其发明者的数据与芬兰雇主-雇员数据相关联，估算了专利发明对个人收入的影响。回报具有异质性：发明者因获得专利授权可获得相当于年收入3%的临时奖励，而对于高被引专利，三年后其收入可获得30%的长期溢价。类似的中期溢价也适用于最初持有专利权的发明者，尽管他们在专利授权时放弃了部分收入。
